contexts.text: When the understanding has been coupled to the will, or faith to love, the man is called by the Lord a married land ().

She is married to a husband () = that the doctrine of true faith is... conjoined with the Celestial... Here, therefore, married to a husband = that truth is so conjoined with good that truth also is good.
More sons than the sons of her that is married () = more truths than the truths of the former devastated Church.
She is not allowed to go out until the day she is to be married.
She that is married = the Jews who had the Word.
Provided (the pellicacy) is not with a married woman.
The like as when they were first married, or conjoined in marriage...
The sons of her that is married = the truths with those who are in the Church.
The Church which has the Word, from which the Lord is known, is meant by her that is married who has not sons.
